label: SMOKE fixture — PolitiFact verdict
summary: PolitiFact rated the claim Mostly True: 'accurate but needs some additional information.' Matches the Commonwealth Fund's June 2025 analysis ranking Florida 49th of 51 (states + DC) in 'avoidable hospital use and cost.' Caveat: the category includes data not exclusive to hospitals (e.g., Medicare spending, imaging costs).
title: PolitiFact: David Jolly on Florida hospital costs

numerical_discrepancy.note: Correct number (49th of 51); underlying metric is 'avoidable hospital use and cost' — slightly broader than 'hospital costs' alone. Number exact; framing caveat routes to mostly_true.
